sources.title: GitHub - AnswerDotAI/ModernBERT: Bringing BERT into modernity via both ...
sources.snippet: This is the repository where you can find ModernBERT, our experiments to bring BERT into modernity via both architecture changes and scaling. This repository noticeably introduces FlexBERT, our modular approach to encoder building blocks, and heavily relies on .yaml configuration files to build models.

sources.title: ModernBERT-large: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: For multilingual applications, consider modernbert-ja-130m for Japanese content or alternatives trained on multilingual data. Q: What is the difference between using ModernBERT-large and GPT-2 Large? A: ModernBERT-large is an encoder model optimized for understanding and retrieval, while gpt2-large is a decoder model for text generation.

sources.title: ModernBERT-large by answerdotai, Fill Mask | Mixpeek Model Hub
sources.snippet: On Mixpeek, ModernBERT-large runs as a managed extractor inside a processing pipeline. Point a bucket of fill mask data at it, and Mixpeek handles GPU provisioning, batching, retries, and writing the outputs into a vector store you can query.
